name: Philia Salis
source:
Philia is a queen from another world who accidentally ended up in the snack shop after crossing through a portal in her closet.

She goes by the name "Queen Salt," and her particular way of speaking seems to prove that she is a true royalty. 

As she visits the snack shop every week for shaved ice, she grows closer and closer to the cook...

[From [url=https://cfk.kr/miracle/en.php]Official English site[/url]]
